comments.body: Need to confirm whether search's heavier cost multiplier should show effective remaining or raw counter units.

content.text: Need to confirm whether search's heavier cost multiplier should show effective remaining or raw counter units.

Clients today only learn remaining budget when they finally hit 429 or when they call a separate quota endpoint. Embedding budget on success responses lets them pace batches without extra round-trips.
On every successful authenticated response, emit RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, and RateLimit-Reset (unix seconds) consistent with the hourly window that applied to that route class.
Acceptance: header values match the Redis counter within one request of race; unauthenticated public GETs omit the headers; changelog entry and SDK response wrapper expose remaining as a number.
